skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature of economic models as research tools and apply optimization tools to describe economic behavior.
Use different theories to analyze consumer behavior, construct individual demand functions, and analyze policies.
Describe risk concepts such as expected value, variance, and standard deviation, and decision-making criteria under risk conditions.
Analyze short-term and long-term production functions and scale efficiency.
Understand characteristics of market structures and pricing methods for businesses in various market structures.
Define and determine labor supply and demand for firms, industries, and markets in the short term and long term.
Develop independent research skills, analysis, synthesis, and generalization of microeconomic issues.
Develop group work and presentation skills to convey knowledge through writing and discussing real-world microeconomic policy scenarios.
Enhance self-learning abilities and organize group activities to complete assigned tasks.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and solve complex microeconomic problems.
